submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 1.5 mm gas gap is recommended as it is the only mixture that satisfies the hard environmental constraint (GWP100 ≤ 150) while achieving the best possible time resolution within the allowed parameter space. Simulation results for Mixture-G2 across different gap sizes (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm) show that the 1.5 mm gap delivers the optimal time resolution of 1.95 ns. While Mixture-G1 and Mixture-G3 showed better time resolution at 2 mm gap (0.9 ns and 1.3 ns respectively), both exceed the mandatory GWP100 limit of 150 and are therefore ineligible. The 1.5 mm gap falls well within the specified range of 1-3 mm.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Among eligible mixtures, Mixture-G2 at 1.5 mm gap achieves 1.95 ns time resolution, which is the best achievable while respecting all constraints. This was determined by scanning gap sizes from 1-3 mm.
